tools.name: get_polish_savings_bonds_offer
tools.description: Polish retail treasury savings bonds (obligacje oszczędnościowe Skarbu Państwa: OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO, ROS, ROD) currently on sale: series code, term, first-period interest rate, inflation margin and early redemption fee, from the official issue letters of the Polish Ministry of Finance.

tools.name: get_polish_savings_bond_series
tools.description: Details of one Polish retail treasury savings bond series by its code (for example EDO1136 or COI1130): terms, margin, early redemption fee and the interest rate in every interest period that has started.

tools.name: get_retail_government_bonds_by_country
tools.description: Whether a country sells government bonds to individuals at issue and how they pay (inflation plus a fixed margin, market real rate, fixed, floating, step-up or prize), for all 195 countries, with the official source for each. Without a country: the number of countries in each category and the countr

tools.name: get_eu_bank_account_opening_bonuses
tools.description: Banks in the 27 EU countries that pay a cash bonus for opening a personal current account, read one by one from bank websites, with the amount, deadline and source page. With a country code: every bank paying a bonus there. Without it: the number of banks with a bonus in each country.
